name: Gilgamesh
desc: The King of Heroes from the dawn of human history, hailing from a world beyond the stars.\nPossessing a nature two-thirds divine and one-third mortal, he claims a natural-born prerogative to rule over all of creation.

stories.0:
The King of Heroes from the dawn of human history, hailing from a world beyond the stars.
Being two-thirds divine and one-third mortal, he claims a natural-born prerogative to rule over all of creation.
Today, as ever, his boisterous laughter echoed through the heavens... until a certain goddess and eternal rival dragged him into a foreign realm.
Now, he sets forth once more to reclaim all that belongs to a king.
stories.1: "He beheld the ocean's deepest abysses and the very foundations of the Earth; he knew where all secrets lay, and all things were revealed to him." The epic records the king's final chapter: he attained absolute wisdom, witnessed every treasure, and unveiled the mysteries of the gods. He returned from a thousand-mile journey utterly spent, yet blessed with a peace transcending all earthly things, and set down the story of his life. "Hmph, what a shallow, pitiful fool you are. "Are you seriously suggesting that I was somehow mightier in that withering, aged form than the perfected one standing before you?" No, no, no! Of course not! Perhaps that introduction was a touch one-sided. Allow me to try a different angle. Gilgamesh, history's most ancient King of Heroes. Unlike the countless heroes throughout the ages driven by lofty ideals, his power springs from an appetite that can never be sated. From the ocean where the sun rises to the snow-capped peaks where it sets, every facet of human civilization was shaped under his guidance: boundless cities, boundless orchards, boundless mines... With superhuman vigor, he commanded everything his eyes could survey. Yet the very king who made the whole world flourish also worked his subjects to the bone... "Watch your tongue. How dare you let such clumsy metaphors reach my ears. One wrong word, and you'll lose your head. "But this once, I'll show mercy and spare your life." Huh? "At least you faithfully documented my great deeds... Hmph, though in truth, you've barely scratched the surface. "Indeed... Ultimate power, ultimate extravagance, ultimate authority, this is my way. "If such a ruler did not exist in this world, those mediocre fools who cower before tyranny yet lack the spine to strike down my head would have perished long ago, crushed beneath the gods' pathetic whims." As you can see, dear reader: Gilgamesh is the sort of stubborn character who takes "doing whatever he pleases" to its absolute extreme. Now, in that age when gods treated mortals like weeds and beasts roamed the land unchecked, the king's logic held some water... but everything has its limits. When even newlywed couples had to revolve around the king like spinning tops, the people's complaints rose to the heavens themselves. Pushed by the goddess Ishtar, the gods — already fearful of humanity's relentless progress — decided to forge an unbreakable "Enkidu" to rein in the arrogant King. And so, filled with joy, Enkidu descended to the mortal realm.
stories.2: "The Epic got it right: our first encounter was indeed before the altar of the sacred marriage ceremony." "Hmph... To think a mere clod of dirt would dare spew such nonsense, claiming they would 'correct my arrogance.'" "Utterly absurd." Despite these words, the king — for reasons unknown, though I boldly guess it was out of sheer surprise or even rage at meeting a worthy opponent for the very first time — finally took the fight seriously. Enkidu's form ebbed and flowed at will, shaping incalculable weapons that swept toward the king like a torrential storm. In the face of this desperate impasse, the king, in a rare moment of imitation, did the unthinkable: he flung wide the gates of his treasury, heartlessly casting forth his riches as a hail of stones. "If it's an opponent of equal standing, it wouldn't matter even if the coffers ended up completely empty." Reaching this point in the story, the king added this unprompted remark. His perpetually furrowed brow seemed to relax a fraction as he shifted his gaze to the sky outside the window. Soon, the tale resumed: Despite pulling out all the stops, the king simply couldn't suppress that "mere clod of dirt." The battle ended without a victor. "Back then, we had yet to understand what survival even meant." "To keep fighting would have only added two more foolish corpses to the pile." The clay tablets bearing the epic are hopelessly fragmented here, so no one knows why Enkidu agreed to make peace with Gilgamesh. Perhaps the old adage of "friendship forged in battle" is the best explanation we have. Regardless, Enkidu joined Uruk. For the very first time, this great city had someone who could stand shoulder-to-shoulder with the king. The king remained as willful as ever. Only this time, the people of Uruk could finally find genuine joy in his antics. Together with Enkidu, he slaughtered the demonic beast Huwawa in the cedarwood forest, and later struck down the Bull of Heaven, Gugalanna, sent by the goddess Ishtar in a fit of spite. The list of such heroic legends is endless... In this crisis-ridden world, they briefly became champions whose names thundered across the lands. "To truly practice what they call 'protection,' summoning a biting north wind is sometimes a necessary evil." The age when the gods could casually summon a flood to bring about an apocalypse is truly gone forever... But laying a lethal curse upon a legendary hero? That, they can still do without breaking a sweat.
stories.3: Enkidu was dead. Everyone knew this was a curse from the Gods. Humans had long understood that defying the divine would carry a price; yet, when the toll was finally called, everyone seemed caught utterly off guard... Especially the king, who had once boasted that he "knew not the meaning of the fear of death." "Absurd. How could I possibly shed tears over the death of a friend?" "Come to think of it, I am the one who reigns over all creation; how could I possibly possess an existence known as a 'friend'?" "Even if I did have one, I've forgotten their name." ...An answer that avoided the question. At any rate, as the epic tells: Gilgamesh departed Uruk. He crossed mountains and rivers until he reached a tavern at the edge of the world. The master of the tavern was Siduri. She interrogated Gilgamesh on his origins until she was certain the traveler was worthy of her guidance. Only then did she reveal the secret of how to cross the world's end to reach the land of eternal life. There dwelt the most ancient of men, Utnapishtim, known in Sumerian as Ziusudra. A survivor of the Great Flood of antiquity, he had lived in isolation until the present era. "Ah, I remember him." "One who obtained immortality by being inscribed into the divine registers. And for that very same reason, lost his form of flesh and blood, becoming an existence more wretched than even the flora of the earth..." "...Utterly foolish. Had this been the only cost of immortality, I would never accept it." Left with no choice, the elder bestowed Gilgamesh another secret, so that he might obtain eternal life and youth without having to beg the gods for mercy. "Even if that old fellow lied to me, it would still be a rare treasure, worthy enough to adorn my treasury." "Thus, this king set out once more on a journey to find the 'herb of immortality'." And so it was, but unfortunately... "...There is nothing to be regretful about. I found the herb, sealed it in a bottle, and returned to Uruk. Exactly as the legend says, without a single lie." "Now then, let this interview end here. My time is precious, and I must now see to matters regarding my banned streaming channel." Unfortunately, O king, there is no escape. The true conclusion of the epic is as follows: While Gilgamesh was bathing and changing his clothes to return to Uruk, he watched helplessly as a common snake swallowed the herb... Yet in that moment, the king could not help but burst into laughter, laughing until his body and face were nearly distorted. By the time he came to his senses, the light of dawn had broken once more. Later, the king returned to Uruk, empty-handed. Future readers, please do not blame Gilgamesh, for the wanderer must always return home.
stories.4: The epic concludes here. The contents of the final tablet are more akin to a brief encore performance following the fall of a grand opera's curtain. Times have changed. Millennia later, Gilgamesh became a Heroic Spirit because of this very epic. "Fool! It is not that I became a Heroic Spirit because of the epic. It is that the epic, through my telling of it, finally attained such value!" "Before me, the world was ruled by gods. After me, the world was returned to humanity. It is true that Uruk has long since fallen to ruin, but no city can escape such a fate, not even {RUBY_B#The Great God's Aquatic Capital}the Abzu of Enlil{RUBY_E#}." "Yet humans are unlike gods. They build new cities, allowing new life to endure in new lands. Therefore..." "Every city of man is my Uruk, and all are worthy of my dominion and my lash!" ...What on earth is this man rambling on about? And yet, unexpectedly, though his words are full of grievances, no trace of anger can be heard in the king's laughter. "Enough. Return to the battlefield, security officer. We have much to do." "The scarcity of food, the ravages of disease, the monotony of pleasure... You have gradually overcome these human deficiencies, yet the 'ego' continues to wither amidst sickly indulgences..." "This land is already diseased to the core. But as long as I stand here, this city shall not fall." Good grief, the King of Heroes is still the same as ever. Fearless since the Age of Gods, forever holding his own standards as the absolute law. "Of course, before that... you must reclaim every last one of my scattered treasures." "Otherwise, by the time I personally raze this land in place of those foul things lurking in the abyss, it will be too late for regrets." ...There he goes again with the classic villain speech. Still, I have already found the answer I was looking for. Now, together with everyone else, let us head to the battlefield once more.

voicelines.voice_m: Stellaron, my treasure. When you reach the end of your journey, I shall seal you within the deepest depths of my treasury, in the safest place of all... Hmph. That said, your Trailblaze shall endure for a long time yet, reaching even beyond the ultimate horizon of my own foresight.
Since you're a treasure and not a subject, there's no need to grovel at my feet.
There are plenty of other treasures waiting around for my affection. You're dismissed.
My class? Boring. How could a class shorter than my own exalted name possibly encompass my multifaceted majesty?! Let that faker take pride in claiming such a trivial title.
Life is nothing but "dying now" or "dying later." In other words, once I deem that something "should vanish at once," be it warrior, god, or treasure, I'll show no mercy.

I have gathered every treasure in existence and built a vault known as the "Gate of Babylon." Its contents are so vast that I sealed many chambers away without even glancing at them... Hm? I have no intention of leaving you in a place like that. At the very least, it has to be the ultimate inner sanctum guarded by seven layers of seals!

You expect me to call you a "friend"? Hah! I like that gumption that fears not even a god! Yet, abandon such thoughts. The only existence I could call my dear friend is already a part of my past. Now, speak of this no more.

Indulge in your desires, challenge all, conquer all, plunder all, crush any existence that dares obstruct my pursuit of Elation. If one does not live thus as a human, what difference is there from those mongrel beasts who only know how to grovel and beg?

The "Golden Rule" may appear a blessing, yet it is a curse in truth. Upon manifesting in this era, I initiated a livestream to secure funds for my endeavors. Within mere moments, I had earned a fortune and was promptly banned. I did naught but grace them with a glimpse of my august form, yet they lost their wits with infatuation. Mongrels, the lot of them.
I do not merely plunder. I also bestow all that you have earned. Be proud. That I recognize such merit in you is proof enough that you are a treasure beyond compare.
Humans are fools, yet the things they create possess true value. This universe of yours is the ultimate proof of my judgment.
To a King, a nation is nothing more than a possession. If you cannot dominate it, you might as well cast aside the crown. That is why she was consumed by her own nation.
He's got brawn and brains in spades. But for all his skill with that lance, he's not quite ready to be called a king.

A "champion of justice"? A world where no one gets hurt? He says such ridiculous things. The pretense of equality is nothing more than drivel by the weak who cannot face darkness. His ideal is just an excuse to cover up ugliness.
Once you've chosen the path of the arcane, you can only march toward something beyond human — but perhaps that girl, an Average One, can truly Trailblaze a path never seen before.

Donning that girl's face seems to have made that useless goddess look a good deal brighter. Although I shall never forgive the transgressions of her past... Hmph. It is a fortunate turn of events that she has learned a modicum of discipline within the confines of a mortal vessel.

A true hero is one who shoulders all they behold, without exception. I had thought myself the only existence capable of enduring the collective weight of this world, to think this cosmos held another capable of such a feat. However, a flaw remains. He is far too humble! If one possesses the strength to bear the world, he need not call himself a Deliverer. He must claim the title of king!
So, the participant paired against me is that "broken-legged wolf"? Hardly a surprise. If you are looking for someone whose losses could rival my own, you will find no other in this Holy Grail War.

In that vast universe, those who share my refined tastes are few and far between. For the most part, humans are nothing more than beasts devoid of self-awareness. Since you have found your resolve, the next step is slaying gods. I look forward to that day with great anticipation.

That security officer is far from the simple-looking girl she appears to be. Quiet as she may seem, once she is moved to action, she becomes a merciless, unrestrained beast of pure performance... Hmph. Why must I always be surrounded by such eccentricities?
The king acknowledges it. The king permits it. The king shoulders the entire world.
To gaze upon the majesty of my origins? Such audacious impudence!
Hmph. It seems I must show you my true might. Be grateful for such a spectacle, won't you?
This pittance isn't worth a glance! See the Echo of War over there? Do not keep your King waiting!
My treasure must be the finest of the fine. See that you do not disappoint me!
King of Knights, I permit you to challenge my might.
Faker. See how a true original outshines an impostor.

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Rin Tohsaka
voicelines.voice_m: Not Ishtar, but you yourself? Good. You just cheated fate.
Struggle and crawl for your life as best you can, mongrel.
Allow me to savor the unsightly spectacle of your hollow bravado.
You dare call this a "battle"?
What a pitiable expression. On your knees.
Slow as a snail's crawl... Unlike you, I have no intention of dying from overwork.
Boring.
Very well, I shall indulge you in a bit of play.
Excellent. My interest has been piqued.
The stage is yours, Enkidu!
Behold and worship! Hahahahahaha!
Tch.
Why you! You! YOU!
Awaken, Ea!
Gaze upon the primordial truth — Enuma Elish!
Hahahahahahahaha!
What a magnificent view!
I'll retreat this time...!
Rejoice, for your king has returned!
Heh... Truly, a sight as refreshing as an oasis in the desert.
I shall restrain them!
To rule over all creation, there is none more suited for it than me!
A bargain-bin scrap. I shall deign to add it to my coffers regardless.
Rubbish. I shall deign to add it to my coffers regardless.
A modicum of worth. I shall deign to add it to my treasury regardless.
Should this lock not have undone itself the moment I cast my gaze upon it? How utterly insolent.
To think you would force me to lower my own hands to the task... You are hereby banished to the depths of the shadows!
Mongrel, you are an eyesore. Go, strike him down.
Raucous, empty noise... This place possesses none of Uruk's vitality.

1.name: He Who Saw the Deep
1.desc: When Gilgamesh holds "King's Acknowledgement," its DEF-ignoring effect also applies to other teammates, and "King's Acknowledgement" additionally increases Gilgamesh's ATK by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. When using Skill, additionally regenerates a fixed <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Energy.

2.name: Wisdom That Encompassed All
2.desc: When entering combat, Gilgamesh gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> "Interest." When using Ultimate, additionally gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> "Interest." The DMG multiplier of the Skill "Gate of Babylon" against the primary target increases by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>, and its DMG multiplier against adjacent targets increases by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.

3.name: Journey That Spanned Far
3.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

30000007.name: Energy Regeneration Rate
30000007.desc: Energy Regeneration Rate can boost the amount of Energy a character gains when performing actions such as using abilities, defeating enemies, or taking DMG.\nA higher rate means faster Energy regeneration.\nHowever, certain Energy-Regenerating effects won't be impacted by this rate.

5.name: Sword That Parted Gods from Man
5.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

6.name: Soul That Bore Friendship
6.desc: Increases the bounce DMG multiplier of the Ultimate "Enuma Elish" by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. While Gilgamesh is on the field, increases ally characters' All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. When a teammate uses Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Golden Rule," up to a total of <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> points. When this unit uses Ultimate, consumes all "Golden Rule" points, and each point of "Golden Rule" consumed increases the CRIT DMG for the Ultimate DMG dealt by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.

30000005.name: RES PEN
30000005.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

150901.name: Halfhearted Blow
150901.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy.
150901.simple_desc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

150902.name: Gate of Babylon
150902.desc: Gains "King's Acknowledgement," allowing this unit to ignore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> of the target's DEF when dealing DMG, lasting for <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nDeals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to adjacent targets.
150902.simple_desc: Gains "King's Acknowledgement," enabling this unit to ignore part of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. Deals Lightning DMG to one enemy and Lightning DMG to adjacent targets.

150903.name: Enuma Elish
150903.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK to one random enemy.
150903.simple_desc: Deals <color=#f29e38ff>massive Lightning DMG</color> to all enemies. Additionally deals minor Lightning DMG to random enemies, bouncing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).

150904.name: "Amuse Me to the Fullest"
150904.desc: When a teammate uses their Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains "King's Burden," which increases Ultimate DMG dealt by this unit by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nInitially, automatically uses Basic ATK at the start of this unit's turn. When another ally target takes action, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Interest." For each point of "Interest" in possession, increases this unit's SPD by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>.\nWhen "Interest" reaches <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> for the first time, enters the "Interest Piqued!" state. In that state, can only use Skill, lasting for the entire battle. After using Skill, clears this unit's "Interest."
150904.simple_desc: When a teammate <color=#f29e38ff>uses their Ultimate</color>, Gilgamesh gains "King's Burden," which <color=#f29e38ff>increases Ultimate DMG dealt</color> by this unit.\nInitially, automatically uses Basic ATK at the start of this unit's turn. When another ally target takes action, Gilgamesh <color=#f29e38ff>gains 1 point of "Interest"</color>. For each point of "Interest" in possession, <color=#f29e38ff>increases SPD</color> for this unit.\nWhen "Interest" reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> for the first time, enters the "Interest Piqued!" state. In that state, can only use Skill, lasting for the entire battle. After using Skill, clears this unit's "Interest."

150905.name: "I Grant You Permission To Strike"
150905.desc: When Gilgamesh or <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> attacks, the attack tally increases by 1. After any unit attacks, if the attack tally reaches <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>, Gilgamesh and <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> launch <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Gilgamesh's ATK and Wind DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Saber's ATK to all enemies, respectively. Then, Gilgamesh gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Interest." <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> regenerates a fixed <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Energy, and the next time she uses Ultimate, the DMG dealt becomes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.\nAfter using <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u>, resets the attack tally.
150905.simple_desc: When Gilgamesh or <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> attacks, the attack tally increases. After any unit attacks, if the attack tally reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak></color>, Gilgamesh and <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> launch <u>Joint Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing massive Lightning DMG and massive Wind DMG to all enemies. Gilgamesh <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "Interest."</color> <unbreak>Saber</unbreak> regenerates Energy and additionally increases the DMG of her next Ultimate.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

10000019.name: Joint Attack
10000019.desc: Multiple targets respectively use attacks on enemy targets in one action.

150906.name: Attack
150906.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

150907.name: Enkidu
150907.desc: After using Technique, creates 1 Special Dimension lasting for <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> second(s). Enemies in the Special Dimension enter the "King's Permission" state. Enemies in the "King's Permission" state will cease all actions.\nWhen entering combat by actively attacking an enemy in the "King's Permission" state, causes all enemies in the "King's Permission" state to enter combat, and deals Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies after entering combat. Gilgamesh also immediately gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Interest." Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
150907.simple_desc: Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies in the Special Dimension enter the "King's Permission" state and cease all actions.\nAttacking an enemy in the "King's Permission" state causes all enemies in the "King's Permission" state to enter combat simultaneously. After entering combat, deals Lightning DMG to all enemies and immediately <color=#f29e38ff>gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> "Interest."</color>
